changelog: Backtesting drawing tools: added a per-user, per-tool 'Save as default' / 'Reset to default' template for the fib retracement tool. Previously every new fib was built purely from the hardcoded BT_TOOL_DEFAULTS.fib_retracement settings — a trader's customised levels/colours lived only on the one drawing they were set on, and were lost the moment that drawing was deleted or a new one was drawn, unlike TradingView's own behaviour of remembering the last-used (or explicitly saved) template.

New table user_drawing_defaults (migration 2026_09_29_0001), one row per (user, tool), storing a tool's settings object. Three new routes on BacktestDrawingController, all scoped to the logged-in user: get_drawing_defaults, save_drawing_default (INSERT ... AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE — MySQL 8.0.19+ row-alias syntax, confirmed supported on this project's live MySQL 8.4 host), reset_drawing_default.

js/backtest-drawings.js loads this user's saved defaults once per session open (loadBtDrawingDefaults(), alongside the existing loadBtDrawings()). A new drawing's settings — and its live drag preview, so the preview never shows something different from what actually gets saved — are now btMergedToolDefaults(tool): the code's own BT_TOOL_DEFAULTS deep-merged with the user's saved default, with fib's levels array merged by ratio rather than array index specifically so a ratio added to the code later still appears even for a user who saved their default before that ratio existed.

The fib settings panel gains a Template row with 'Save as default' (saves the currently-open drawing's settings as this user's default for the tool) and 'Reset to default' (deletes the saved default; never touches the drawing itself, or any other existing drawing). Both toast on success/error. Generic by tool via a BT_TEMPLATE_TOOLS list — fib is the only tool opted in this release, so another tool can get the same two buttons later with a one-line change, no new plumbing.
Also fixed: loadBtDrawings() previously only logged a load failure to console.warn, silently — it now also shows a toast, matching every other failure path in this file.

Existing drawings are never modified by saving or resetting a default (verified: neither save_drawing_default nor reset_drawing_default touches backtest_drawings at all), and neither table is read by the replay/order/challenge engine — unchanged constraints from v3.21.0.
release_notes: New migration 2026_09_29_0001_create_user_drawing_defaults.sql — CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS only, no MariaDB-only syntax. After Update Now, run migrate.php?mode=status then mode=run to apply it (this is in addition to, not instead of, the four backtest migrations already pending from earlier releases).
